card.text: A Cepheid in the Milky Way that swells and shrinks every 30.1 days.

sources.label: Groenewegen (2012)
sources.locator: table10, AQ Pup: Per, Rad, Dist

introduction.text: Its mean radius, 137.2 solar radii, comes from comparing how fast its surface moves with how its size changes, 2,991 parsecs away.
